distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Chongqing and Sichuan. Smith et al. (2022) additionally records Yunnan, with locality evidence from Yunnan, Xishuangbanna.

host_note: Species-level host Prunus yedoensis from Smith et al. (2020) is retained. Smith et al. (2022) reports no host for this record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Microperus fulvulus (Schedl, 1942).

nomenclature_note: Smith et al. (2020) reinstates Microperus fulvulus as a species; canonical authorship follows integrated taxonomic backbone: (Schedl, 1942), VSN_3680.
